title: The Effect of a System for Sharing Best Practices Within Pre-Existing Peer Networks
eligible_reason: Single-date field intervention. The System for Sharing Best Practices started for treatment stores in one week. Store-week regressions of log sales on Post and Tr_Post include store FE, week FE, store-specific linear trends (c.time#i.store_id) and post x time slopes (P_time, TrP_time) (Table 3; Tables 4-8 add moderators). The footnote-24 check uses Post and Tr_Post with region x month FE and a linear time trend. One adoption date, with unit trends in the main columns. Company data are not shipped.
